Hey there,
This is probably a stupid question, but I could'nt find a conclusive
answer.

How does Yong-Sun's specials (both the basic and the advanced)
interact with Imbued?

Sabbat Cardinal: As a (D) action, Yong-Sun may burn the top vampire of
your prey's crypt.
Advanced, Sabbat cardinal: Yong-Sun gets +X bleed, where X is the
number of vampires in the target Methuselah's ash heap.

Does his special treat the Imbued as normal vampires here, or?

Thanks for putting a close to a discussion I'm having with some people
on this subject.

Greetz
Jo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Wolflord wrote:
> How does Yong-Sun's specials (both the basic and the advanced)
> interact with Imbued?
>
> Sabbat Cardinal: As a (D) action, Yong-Sun may burn the top vampire of
> your prey's crypt.

Official (most-recent-printing) card text:
Yong-Sun may burn the top card of your prey's crypt as a (D) action

So no problem there.

> Advanced, Sabbat cardinal: Yong-Sun gets +X bleed, where X is the
> number of vampires in the target Methuselah's ash heap.
>
> Does his special treat the Imbued as normal vampires here, or?

No. The basic ability (burn top crypt card) works. But the +X only counts
vampires in the ash heap, and won't count imbued (or any other allies, for that
matter).
